channel.title: MiniNotes Changelog
channel.description: Most recent changes with links to updates.

item.title: Version 0.3.2
item.description:
What's New

  • Cursor now follows the system appearance: white in dark mode, black in light mode.
  • Thinner text cursor matching Obsidian's caret style.
  • Menu bar icon now rescues itself if a menu bar manager (e.g. Ice) pushes it off-screen — checked at launch, on app reopen, and when opening the panel.

item.title: Version 0.3.1
item.description:
What's New

  • Auto Update: toggle in Settings to check for updates once per day.
  • Keyboard shortcuts: Cmd+1/2/3 to switch between Source, Edit, and View modes.
  • Edit mode icon updated to match Obsidian's pencil-with-underline style.

item.title: Version 0.3.0
item.description:
What's New

  • Horizontal rule: --- lines now render as a clean divider line.
  • Strikethrough: ~~text~~ renders with line-through styling.
  • Images: ![alt](url) renders inline images in the editor.
  • Inline code: backtick delimiters are now hidden in preview mode.
  • Highlight: ==text== renders with yellow highlight background.
  • Footnotes: [^1] references render as superscript; definitions are styled.
  • Math: $inline$ and $$display$$ math styled with monospace font.
  • Nested blockquotes: >> and >>> now indent progressively.
  • HTML blocks: raw HTML is styled in dimmed monospace.
  • Fixed: table bottom padding reduced to eliminate extra whitespace.
